_about: Gemini conversation data from Nikhil's 7 Gemini chats (21 turns) on 2026-11-15 with probe/probe.js. Positional arrays, so paths are listed by slot. Types only. Request: POST /_/BardChatUi/data/batchexecute, rpcids=hNvQHb, f.req=[[["hNvQHb", JSON.stringify(["c_"+id, pageSize, cursor, 1, [0], [4,12], null, 1]), null, "generic"]]], at=SNlM0e. Response: the line starting [["wrb.fr", then JSON.parse of element [0][2].

response.data[1]: string cursor for the next (older) page; absent on the last page

turn.t[1]: parent turn's [c_, r_, rc_]; missing on the first turn, or present with blank r_ and rc_
turn.t[3][0]: array of answer candidates (1 per turn in every sample)
turn.t[3][0][0][1]: array of strings: the answer text parts (1 part in every sample); missing when the answer is empty
turn.t[3][0][0][37]: array, up to about 10,000 characters per answer (thinking, to confirm at build)
turn.t[3][21]: string (model label, 9 or 14 chars; to confirm)
turn.t[4]: [seconds, nanoseconds]: when the turn was created

verified.parentLinks: each turn's t[1][1] and t[1][2] equal the next-older turn's t[0][1] and t[3][0][0][0]: 17 links, 0 broken
verified.paging: page size 10 on an 11-turn chat: page one 10 turns plus a cursor, page two 1 turn and no cursor; page size 100: all 11, no cursor
verified.emptyAnswers: 2 first turns had no t[3][0][0][1] and a blank parent; what the page shows for them is checked in the Gemini build step
